YOUR INFORMATION

Privacy & analytics.

Clear choices. Thoughtful browsing.

Updated 18 October 2026. This notice describes how the Toldit Group website handles browsing information and inquiries.

When you browse

Vercel hosts this website and processes technical request information, such as IP addresses and browser details, to deliver pages and help protect the service. These essential hosting functions are separate from optional analytics. Fonts are requested from Google Fonts, which receives the connection information needed to deliver them.

Optional analytics

With your permission, we load Google Analytics and Vercel Web Analytics to understand page visits and interest in our developing ranges. Google Analytics uses cookies and can receive browsing, device, approximate location and interaction information. Vercel Web Analytics is designed to measure traffic without analytics cookies.

Our inquiry-click event records the product or concept name, contact channel and proposed format where selected. It measures a button click, not a sent message, order or sale. We do not ask for personal details in analytics events. Our page-view configuration removes URL query strings and fragments, and our site search field is not sent as a custom event. Google’s automatic measurement may also record interactions such as outbound link clicks.

Neither optional analytics script loads until you choose Allow analytics. No thanks keeps both off. We store your choice in your browser’s local storage. Use Analytics preferences below to change it; withdrawing permission reloads the page and removes accessible Google Analytics cookies for this site. Browser privacy controls may also block measurement. When Do Not Track is enabled, optional analytics stays off.

When you contact us

Email and WhatsApp links open the service you choose with a draft inquiry. Nothing is sent to Toldit until you send it. Your chosen provider processes the message under its own policy. If you send an inquiry, Toldit receives the details you include and your contact information to respond and continue the conversation. Avoid sending passwords, payment details or other sensitive information.

Service providers and information handling

Hosting, analytics, font and communication providers may process information in countries other than your own. Their policies explain their processing and retention practices. This website does not accept payments, orders or account registrations. You can contact Toldit about access, correction or deletion of information you have shared; we will review the request and explain any limits that apply.

Contact about privacy

Email tolditgroup@gmail.com with your question and enough detail for us to identify the information concerned.
